{{Quote|It's all all about a stealthy approach, you see. Stealth, and a nice big Cip-Quad, of course.|[[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]]|<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
The '''reciprocating quad blaster cannon''', often shortened to "'''Cip-Quad'''," was an experimental [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannon]] weapon developed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]].<ref name="TZ" />

==Description==
The reciprocating quad blaster drew power from a power cell strapped to a soldier's back and was mounted on a specialized harness featuring [[Repulsorlift/Legends|microrepulsorlifts]].<ref name="TZ" /> The four barrels could be fired either one or two at a time depending on the rotation pattern selected, and were cooled on the recoil by coolant tanks located within the rig itself.

[[Advanced Recon Commando heavy gunner|ARC heavy gunners]] using the weapon were outfitted with specialized armor that included head-up displays in the helmet and links to the harness that allowed them to make the best use of the weapon. The weapon was best used against the slower vehicles of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] army, such as the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 tank droid]] and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]], as infantry was often able to outmaneuver the weapon.

==History==
[[File:CipQuadARC.jpg|thumb|150px|An ARC Heavy Gunner trooper pulls out his reciprocating quad blaster]]
The [[The Muunilinst 10|team]] of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC Troopers]] who were sent to rescue the trapped [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Daakman Barrek]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] used this weapon. This team included an [[Advanced Recon Commando heavy gunner|ARC Heavy Gunner]] armed with a reciprocating quad blaster that he used to hold off [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] while other members of the team found the trapped Jedi and attempted to bring them back to their [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]]. However, due to the speed and agility of Grievous, the trooper's efforts to disable the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] were largely unsuccessful.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 21">{{CW|21}}</ref>
